quest.title: Chance Commission
quest.description: Zompaynco from Natlan seems to be troubled by something...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Jahoda? And... Mr. Zompaynco. What can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: I... uhh... about that...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: He wants to visit the Frostmoon Scions, but can't quite bring himself to ask, so he's hoping you'll help him out.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Yes! Yes, that's exactly it!

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: G—Greetings, Miss Lyylikki! It's such a pleasure to meet you. Uh... I brought this fossil specimen from Natlan along...

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Thank you, but Mr. Zompaynco... umm... We've already met, haven't we? You really don't need to be so formal.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Huh? Then... how did you notice me?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: You've always been there when I was distributing meals, haven't you? Wandering around the line, circling back and forth, but never stepping in.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: I thought you might want a serving but were too shy to say so, so I quietly set a portion aside for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: But you've never came around to claim one. In fact, you hadn't shown up today, I was going to ask someone to check and see if you need help or something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Ah... I—I'm so sorry. I've been hesitating, trying to figure out how to say hello...

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: So, Miss Lyylikki... would it be alright if I paid the Frostmoon Scions a visit?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Of course. We've welcomed a few guests from outside before. But may I ask why?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: I'd like to take some photos and notes, look through some records, and if possible... ask someone about the local legends!

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: I'm a member of Natlan's Saurian Relics Association. If I could find materials connected to my research, that would be invaluable.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: I see... so you're hoping to spend some time in the archives, then? Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Well, seeing how you seem to have hit it off, I'll consider this commission complete. Let me get back and report to my boss.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Thank you, Miss Jahoda! But... I really must pay you for your trouble. It'd be wrong to have you come all the way here for nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: And please be sure to convey my gratitude to Boss Nefer when you return.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Of course. I'll take my leave now, then. You two enjoy your chat.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Ah... Jahoda? What brings you here? Hmm... Is Boss Nefer available right now?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Just as I thought, he wants to see Boss Nef... Hmm, I should be able to handle a small matter like this myself.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: No need to go to all that trouble. I'm actually here because my boss sent me to help you.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Huh? Wh—What do you mean? Does that mean Boss Nefer has...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: You've always wanted to visit the Frostmoon Scions, right?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: So, the plan is to befriend Lyylikki first, then ask her to take you to the Frostmoon Scions?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: What!? Lady Nefer knew it all along? But I've kept it locked in my heart and barely told anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Now is the time to use that super cool line that Boss said! What was that line again...? Um... Oh!)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hehe, Mr. Zompaynco, when you guard a secret, you must also learn to hide the fact that you're guarding one.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Otherwise, no matter how tall a wall you build in your heart, sooner or later the wind will find its cracks.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: *Sigh* I was never good at keeping my feelings bottled up, even back when I was still in my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (YES! I said it! All that practice paid off, heheh!)

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Well, now that you know, could you help me make an introduction? I'm an outsider, and I don't want to intrude on Miss Lyylikki.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lyylikki's really kind. Whether you're a complete stranger or in a form not entirely human, she's always warm and welcoming.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Oh? Is that so...?

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: But still, calling on her unannounced is rather impolite... Um, but if you happen to know her...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Of course I do! They should be just about done handing out the meals now. Let's head over.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh! And by the way, Boss also said we won't be charging you this time.

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Oh, thank you so much! I'll go get my things right away.

talks.objective: Accompany Zompaynco to speak with Lyylikki
